policy.privacy: Output is composed only from counts, timestamps, and the closed state and error vocabularies below. Node names, peer addresses, object names, and free-form error text in the evidence are never echoed.

evidence.paused: boolean; an operator or owner paused synchronization
evidence.externalOnly: boolean; the object so far exists only at an external provider (import or provider sync)
evidence.sourceUpdatedAt: integer milliseconds or null; when the source last changed
evidence.queuedAt: integer milliseconds or null; a synchronization is queued
evidence.syncStartedAt: integer milliseconds or null; a synchronization is in flight
evidence.conflicts: integer; conflicting refs or collaboration heads that need a decision
evidence.requiredCopies: integer; verified current copies needed before the state counts as confirmed (minimum 1)
evidence.lastError: string or null; one of reportedErrors, anything else is reported as unknown

copies.status: current | behind | unreachable | rejected (anything else is unreachable)
copies.verified: boolean; the copy's signed attestation verified
copies.trusted: boolean; the copy is a trusted mirror (admitted to serve)
copies.confirmedAt: integer milliseconds or null; the copy's last confirmation

states.label: Verified
states.headline: Every copy is verified and current

states.label: Stale
states.headline: The visible state may be out of date

states.label: Degraded
states.headline: Verified, but some copies are not current

states.label: Conflicted
states.headline: Copies disagree about the latest state

states.label: External only
states.headline: Only stored on the external provider so far

errors.action: Review the conflicting changes and choose which state to keep.
A copy rejected the update; check the node's signing key and push again.
The update's signature did not verify; re-sign it from a trusted device.
This node is not authorized to publish; reconnect the account and retry.
The external provider did not respond; ForkMesh retries automatically.
A network error interrupted synchronization; it retries when the connection returns.
A service quota was reached; synchronization resumes when the quota resets.
Synchronization is taking longer than expected; check that the source node is online.
One or more copies could not be reached; check that the mirrors are online.
A copy reports the latest state without a verified signature; wait for it to re-attest.
Some copies have not received the latest state yet; they normally catch up within minutes.
No copy has confirmed the state recently; check that the mirrors are online.
No copy has confirmed the latest state yet.
An unexpected error stopped synchronization; see the node's log for details.

counts: nodesReached = copies whose status is not unreachable
verifiedCopies = copies that are current and verified
trustedMirrors = verified current copies that are trusted
lastConfirmedAt = newest confirmedAt of a verified copy that is not rejected, else null
precedence: externalOnly and no copies and no lastError -> external-only

verifiedCopies >= requiredCopies: newest current confirmation missing or older than staleAfterMs -> stale (confirmation_expired); verifiedCopies < totalCopies -> degraded (rejected, else unreachable, else unverified, else copies_behind); otherwise verified
syncStartedAt set and not older than syncDeadlineMs -> syncing
queuedAt set and nothing in flight -> queued
any rejected copy -> failed (lastError, else rejected)
derivation.lagMs: 0 when verified; otherwise now - sourceUpdatedAt (floored at 0) when known; else null
derivation.current: true only for verified and degraded

sentences: {verifiedCopies} of {totalCopies copy|copies} verified, {trustedMirrors trusted mirror|trusted mirrors}, {nodesReached node|nodes} reached.
Never confirmed. | Last confirmed just now. (under 60 s) | Last confirmed {age} ago.
summary.age: floor minutes below 60 min -> '{n} min'; floor hours below 48 h -> '{n} h'; otherwise floor days -> '{n} d'

rules: sourceUpdatedAt = summary.freshestSync when non-zero, else null
each mirrors[] row is a copy: status online is required to be reached; integrity rejected -> rejected; behind or integrity healing -> behind; otherwise current
trusted = cloneAvailable or endpointHealthy is true
